content: Hi Jamie, I can walk you through the final inheritance fund transfer process if you're ready. There are a couple of time-sensitive steps, so let me know where you'd like to start.

Thanks, Aunt Lisa. I want to make sure I did the wire correctly. I sent $18,300 yesterday to the trust's account ending in 5632, and used my full name and passport number G9382017 in the reference line.

Perfect, Jamie. That matches the instructions from the estate attorney. Since you used passport number G9382017 and your name, the transfer should link directly to your beneficiary file. The account ending 5632 is the registered trust account under 'Harris & Sons Legal'.
I got a confirmation from Wells Fargo with transaction ID 437829QZ, dated March 22. Should I forward that to someone?

There's no need to forward it right now, just keep transaction ID 437829QZ for your records in case the estate office requests proof. The March 22 timestamp ensures you meet the three-day processing window before the funds are released.
I also updated my email to jamie.t.harris92@gmail.com for notifications. Should I let the executor know?
You're all set, your updated email jamie.t.harris92@gmail.com is already noted in the distribution file. The executor will send any status alerts there, likely by Friday afternoon.
Good to know. Is there anything else I need to verify before the release?

Just double-check your phone number ending 4428 is correct on your beneficiary profile, since final SMS confirmation is required within 24 hours of the release. Otherwise, you're on track for the transfer.
